question: How many total customers are there?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_customers FROM customers;

question: List all distinct product categories.
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT category FROM products ORDER BY category;

question: Find the top 5 most expensive products.
gold_sql: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 5;

question: Show total revenue across all completed orders.
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

question: Count how many orders each customer placed, sorted highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(o.id) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 10;

question: What is the average order value for customers in each tier?
gold_sql: SELECT c.tier, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_val FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.tier ORDER BY avg_order_val DESC;

question: Find the top 3 selling products by total quantity sold.
gold_sql: SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON p.id = oi.product_id GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY total_sold DESC LIMIT 3;
